instructions: Copy your China warehouse address exactly as shown, including your shipping mark.
Write your shipping mark on every carton and give it to your supplier.
Ask your supplier to include the shipping mark in the recipient name and on the waybill.
Choose the warehouse that matches how you want to ship: air freight or sea freight.
Send us the supplier's tracking number once the goods are dispatched.
Goods without a shipping mark can be delayed or lost, so always include it.
